title: retro handheld console
request:
The person asked: "make a handheld console that looks like a game boy". Build a retro handheld game console in the style of the original 1989 Game Boy (DMG-01), for a still render only (not a game asset, not a 3D print).

Defaults chosen by the director (person gave no further details):
- Size: about 90 mm wide, 148 mm tall, 32 mm deep, portrait orientation, matching the original proportions.
- Body: light warm grey plastic shell with slightly rounded edges, and the characteristic larger rounded radius at the bottom-right corner. Subtle seam line between the front and back shell halves.
- Screen area: darker grey bezel taking up the upper part of the front, with a slightly rounded bottom-right corner, a small red power LED dot on the left side of the bezel, and a recessed screen with a pale olive-green LCD color. The screen glass/LCD must sit flush in the bezel and be properly attached, with no floating parts.
- Controls: a black plus-shaped D-pad on the lower left, two round magenta/maroon A and B buttons set at a diagonal on the lower right, and two small slanted grey pill-shaped Start and Select buttons at the bottom center. All buttons sit in shallow recesses and are slightly raised from the shell, attached to it.
- Speaker: a set of six diagonal slanted slots near the bottom-right corner.
- Small details: a short groove line under the top edge, a volume wheel on the right side, a contrast wheel on the left side, a link port on the side, and a headphone jack on the bottom edge. The cartridge slot is on the top back, optionally with a grey cartridge partly inserted.
- No real brand logos or trademarked text. Use generic placeholder text such as "POCKET" or leave the bezel lettering blank.
- Look: clean, realistic product render with soft studio lighting and slightly matte plastic materials. Not cel-shaded.
- Render: front three-quarter view, slightly from above, on a plain light background. The device stands upright or rests at a slight angle, sitting exactly on the floor with no gap or intersection.
- Quality checks: every part is attached to the body, with nothing floating, and the exported file must match the latest edits. Earlier projects had problems with fixes not reaching the export.

spec.object: Retro handheld game console in the style of the original 1989 Game Boy (DMG-01), no brand logos
spec.style: Retro 1980s handheld, clean realistic product render
spec.summary: A portrait-oriented handheld console with a light warm grey two-piece plastic shell, a darker grey bezel framing a pale olive-green LCD in the upper front, and a control layout of a black D-pad on the lower left, two maroon A/B buttons at a diagonal on the lower right, and small grey Start/Select pills at bottom center. Six slanted speaker slots sit near the bottom-right corner, with a volume wheel and contrast wheel on the sides and a cartridge slot on the top back. It is shown as a front three-quarter product render, standing upright on a plain light background.
